ns2:section.sectionText: Exploring Chicago: This course provides career and RST industry exploration. Students will develop networking skills, while engaging with RST industry alumni and professionals in their offices, agencies, and facilities. Best practices and current issues will be explored. Students will have the potential to make connections for future internships and career advancement. Potential site visits and networking opportunities could include Chicago Bears (NFL), Chicago Bulls (NBA), Chicago Cubs and/or Chicago White Sox (MLB), Wintrust Arena, Navy Pier, Oak Lawn Ice Arena, various park districts, Toyota Park, Schaumburg Sport Center, and more. Exact dates of the two-day trip are TBD. Course includes a $160 fee, to cover hotel and transportation. In addition, there will be three one-hour class times scheduled with the trip. Attendance at the meetings is mandatory. Please contact Jason Schroeder schroe24@illinois.edu for further information.
